shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: I currently have equal amounts (1 each) of A, B, and C. Trading away my only A for another B would make my bundle 0 A, 2 B, 1 C, which reduces variety and lowers my utility since I already have B equal to A. I prefer to maintain balance or trade to increase a good I have less of, not swap one for another when both are equally scarce.
